Only byte arrays are passed to the parser. No URL input, remote runtime imports, or CDN.

## Document parsers (v0.3)

`documents/` is generated by `npm run build:documents` with exact direct versions and transitive integrity values in `package-lock.json`:

- PDF.js 6.5.438 (Mozilla, Apache-2.0), legacy display/worker modules and bundled CMap/standard font bytes: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
- word-extractor 1.0.4 (MIT), Word text extraction: https://github.com/morungos/node-word-extractor
- cfb 1.2.2 (Apache-2.0), browser-compatible CFB stream reader: https://github.com/SheetJS/js-cfb
- fflate 0.8.3 (MIT), bounded DOCX ZIP extraction: https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate
- saxes and Browserify runtime dependencies are included with their original licenses in `documents/LICENSES.txt`.

Only byte arrays enter document parsers. PDF external font/CMap requests use an in-memory data factory; embedded scripts, hyperlinks and external resources are not executed or opened. Runtime code and supporting bytes load with the page, without CDN/API requests during checks. `documents/SHA256.json` records generated file hashes.
